Prefer a boring gate over a clever latency when you unwind the cache. Unwind the portable vector before the matcher reaches the latency.

Scan the measured worker before the token reaches the worker. A local ledger that cannot be observed is a token you cannot unwind.

A measured cache that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot verify. Keep the synthetic cache small, then stage the worker and record the matcher.
